description: Redesign conversation list items with premium Jivo-style cards including: 48px circular gradient avatars with hash-based colors, 8px green online indicator dot (bottom-right with white border), visitor name + timestamp on same line, website URL line showing domain, 2-line message preview with line-clamp-2, proper spacing and hover states, active state with blue left border.
steps: 1. Add utility functions at top of inbox-page.tsx after imports: getAvatarColor(name: string) that hashes the name and returns a Tailwind gradient class from palette ['from-indigo-500 to-indigo-600', 'from-purple-500 to-purple-600', 'from-blue-500 to-blue-600', 'from-green-500 to-green-600', 'from-orange-500 to-orange-600', 'from-rose-500 to-rose-600', 'from-cyan-500 to-cyan-600', 'from-pink-500 to-pink-600']
2. Add getWebsiteDisplay(conversation: InboxConversation) utility that returns 'from ' + (conversation.website?.name || extractDomain(conversation.visitor?.currentPageUrl) || 'website')
3. Add extractDomain(url: string | null) utility that safely extracts hostname from URL using try/catch with new URL()
4. Locate the conversation list mapping around line 593: conversations.map((conversation) => <button...)
5. Restructure each conversation card button to use relative positioning for the online indicator
6. Add 48px (size-12) circular avatar with gradient background using getAvatarColor, white text, size-12 rounded-full, with relative positioning

7. Add absolute positioned online indicator: size-2 rounded-full bg-green-500 with ring-2 ring-white, positioned bottom-0 right-0 within the avatar container (use relative parent, absolute child pattern)
8. Layout the text content beside the avatar using flex gap-3: avatar on left (flex-none), content on right (flex-1 min-w-0 for text truncation)
9. First line: flex items-center justify-between with visitor name (font-semibold text-[15px] text-gray-900 truncate) and timestamp (text-[12px] text-gray-500 flex-none)
10. Second line: website URL (text-[12px] text-gray-600 truncate) using getWebsiteDisplay()
11. Third section: message preview (text-[13px] text-gray-700 line-clamp-2 leading-snug) with mt-1
12. Update padding to p-3, add transition-all duration-150, hover:bg-gray-50
13. Active state: when selected, add bg-blue-50 border-l-4 border-blue-600 (already exists, keep it)
14. Keep unread badge in top-right of first line, update to: size-5 min-w-5 rounded-full bg-blue-600 text-white text-[10px] flex items-center justify-center
acceptance_criteria: Each conversation card shows a 48px circular avatar with gradient background color based on visitor name hash
Avatar displays first letter of visitor name in white, centered
Green online indicator dot (8px) appears at bottom-right of avatar with white border ring
Visitor name and timestamp appear on same line with proper alignment (name left, time right)
Website domain or name appears below visitor name in muted color
Message preview shows up to 2 lines with ellipsis using line-clamp-2
Typography follows spec: name 15px semibold gray-900, time 12px gray-500, website 12px gray-600, message 13px gray-700
Hover state shows light gray background with smooth 150ms transition
Active/selected state shows blue background and left border
Different visitors get different gradient colors consistently (same name = same color)
verification: Run 'npm run typecheck' to verify TypeScript types
Start dev server with 'npm run dev'
Navigate to inbox page and verify each conversation card displays:
- Circular gradient avatar with first letter
- Name and time on same line
Verify same visitor names produce same avatar colors across refreshes
Test with conversations having different name lengths and missing data
findings: Successfully implemented premium Jivo-style conversation cards with: 48px circular gradient avatars using hash-based color assignment from 8 distinct gradients, green online indicator (8px) positioned at bottom-right of avatar with white border ring, visitor name and timestamp on same line with proper alignment, website domain/name displayed below visitor name, 2-line message preview with line-clamp-2, updated typography following specifications (name 15px semibold gray-900, time 12px gray-500, website 12px gray-600, message 13px gray-700), smooth hover state with gray-50 background, active state with blue-50 background and blue-600 left border, unread badge integrated in top-right of first line. All TypeScript types passed validation.
